title: Product Sans / Schoolbook
slide_intent: Choose familiar letter structures deliberately so the typographic voice feels approachable to readers.
strategic_value: Schoolbook-inspired forms can support Google’s friendly character without abandoning a geometric system.
demonstration: White lowercase a through h and numerals 1 through 8 occupy two large rows on blue, above a brief rationale.
practical_value: Judge the personality of simple everyday characters before relying on an abstract font description.

content_islands.name: Character rows
content_islands.spec: Align the lowercase row above the numeral row, distributing both across the blue field.

content_islands.name: Style rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the short explanation at lower left beneath the specimens.

reference_purposes.Intent: The caption connects schoolbook letter printing with a simple, friendly and approachable style.
reference_purposes.Expression: The large lowercase and numeral specimens make that character visible.
